scripts.deploy:ecr-login: dotenv -e .env.deploy -e .env.local -- bash -c 'REGION="${AWS_REGION:-ap-northeast-2}"; aws ecr get-login-password --region "$REGION" | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text).dkr.ecr.$REGION.amazonaws.com"'
scripts.deploy:build: dotenv -e .env.deploy -e .env.local -- docker build -f Dockerfile --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL="$NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL" --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN --build-arg SENTRY_ORG --build-arg SENTRY_PROJECT --build-arg SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN -t petlog-frontend ..
scripts.deploy:ecs-force-redeploy: dotenv -e .env.deploy -e .env.local -- bash -c 'REGION="${AWS_REGION:-ap-northeast-2}"; ENV="${PETLOG_ENV:-dev}"; aws ecs update-service --region "$REGION" --cluster "petlog-cluster-$ENV" --service "petlog-frontend-$ENV" --force-new-deployment >/dev/null'
scripts.deploy:image: npm run deploy:check-version && npm run deploy:ecr-login && npm run deploy:build && npm run deploy:ecr-push && npm run deploy:ecs-force-redeploy
